observed.final_answer:
Total cardiovascular risk is estimated using the WHO/ISH risk charts (WHO PEN, Action 3). The charts take the following variables:

- Age (categorized as <40, 40‑49, 50‑59, 60‑69 years)  
- Sex/gender  
- Current smoking status (tobacco use in the past 12 months)  
- Systolic blood pressure  
- Total cholesterol (or the population mean cholesterol value if an assay is not available)  
- Diabetes mellitus status
